5671-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating either a 0/1 green Plant creature token or a 2/2 black Zombie creature token depending on how many uniquely named lands you control
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5702-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-5702-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1429-2292-3545.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4399-4518-5998-7173.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5998-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2034-3536-4907-6989.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to name "Tatterkite".
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {2} due to Cheering Fanatic. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

1069-5285-5499-7175.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-5285-5499-7175.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7156.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

821-3025-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

549-1978-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
549-1978-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4067-6281-6435.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
1805-4067-6281-6435.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Coati Scavenger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Coati Scavenger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Coati Scavenger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

585-3767-3918-4131.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-5315-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-5315-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2558-4848-5687-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

3967-4200-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
3967-4200-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1365-3263-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1365-3263-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

719-862-1789-2232.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1257-3525-3756.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
654-1257-3525-3756.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

653-813-1181.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Fearsome Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1245-2557.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
1245-2557.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.
